/interface ethernet switch
set switch1 l3-hw-offloading=no
/interface ethernet switch l3hw-settings
set autorestart=no ipv6-hw=no
/interface ethernet
set [ find default-name=qsfp28-1-1 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=qsfp28-2-1 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-1 ] comment=Internet
set [ find default-name=sfp28-2 ] comment="Route servers rs1 and rs2"
set [ find default-name=sfp28-3 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-4 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-5 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-6 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-7 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-8 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-9 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-10 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-11 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-12 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=ether1 ] comment=Management
/interface gre
add comment="acme, AS65550" local-address=198.51.100.2 name=vix-acme remote-address=203.0.113.10
add comment="globex, AS65551" local-address=198.51.100.2 name=vix-globex remote-address=192.0.2.20
/ip address
add address=10.0.0.1/24 comment=Management interface=ether1
add address=198.51.100.2/30 comment=Internet interface=sfp28-1
add address=10.254.0.1/24 comment="Route servers rs1 and rs2" interface=sfp28-2
add address=10.254.1.2/31 comment="acme, AS65550" interface=vix-acme
add address=10.254.1.4/31 comment="globex, AS65551" interface=vix-globex
/ip dns
set allow-remote-requests=no servers=""
/ip firewall address-list
add address=203.0.113.10 list=members
add address=192.0.2.20 list=members
/ip firewall filter
add action=accept chain=input comment=Replies connection-state="established,related"
add action=accept chain=input comment="Members' tunnels" protocol=gre src-address-list=members
add action=accept chain=input comment=Management src-address=10.0.0.0/24
add action=drop chain=input comment=Default
add action=accept chain=forward comment="Inside the exchange" dst-address=10.254.0.0/16 src-address=10.254.0.0/16
add action=drop chain=forward comment=Default
/ipv6 firewall filter
add action=accept chain=input comment=Replies connection-state="established,related"
add action=drop chain=input comment=Default
add action=drop chain=forward comment=Default
/ip firewall service-port
set ftp disabled=yes
set tftp disabled=yes
set irc disabled=yes
set h323 disabled=yes
set sip disabled=yes
set pptp disabled=yes
set rtsp disabled=yes
/ip route
add comment=Internet dst-address=0.0.0.0/0 gateway=198.51.100.1
/ip service
set ftp disabled=yes
set ssh address=10.0.0.0/24 disabled=no
set telnet disabled=yes
set www disabled=yes
set www-ssl disabled=yes
set api disabled=yes
set api-ssl disabled=yes
set winbox disabled=yes
set reverse-proxy disabled=yes
/ip ssh
set strong-crypto=yes
/tool mac-server
set allowed-interface-list=none
/tool mac-server mac-winbox
set allowed-interface-list=none
/tool mac-server ping
set enabled=no
/tool bandwidth-server
set enabled=no
/ip neighbor discovery-settings
set discover-interface-list=none protocol=lldp
/snmp
set enabled=no
/snmp community
set [ find default=yes ] addresses=::/0 name=public
/user
add group=full name=operator password="<secret:HUB_01_PASSWORD>"
/ip settings
set send-redirects=no tcp-syncookies=no
/system identity
set name=hub-01
/system clock
set time-zone-autodetect=no time-zone-name=UTC
/system note
set note="" show-at-login=yes
/system ntp client
set enabled=no
/system ntp server
set enabled=no
/system logging action
set 1 disk-file-count=2 disk-lines-per-file=1000
/system package update
set channel=stable
/system routerboard settings
set enter-setup-on=delete-key
/ip traffic-flow
set enabled=no
